segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, it’s Mark from Northstar Metrics. Thanks for making the time. I had us down to talk through adding the field service team and confirming timing for the August 12 go-live, is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that’s right. We’re at 48 users today, and field service would add 22. They don’t all need admin access, just the mobile workflow and dashboards.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So 70 total seats, with the 22 on standard access. On the current pricing sheet, that puts the added annual cost at $18,480, prorated from August 1 through your April 30 renewal. That prorate is $13,860 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Finance will ask if that can stay on the same invoice as the core subscription. They don’t want a separate PO if we can avoid it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can put it on the same account and issue one invoice against the existing PO. The order form will show the added seats as a coterm line item through April 30, then everything renews together.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That helps. On contract terms, no change to the master agreement, right? Legal will get cranky if this opens the whole thing back up.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No change to the master. It’s just an add-on order form, same payment terms, same data processing terms. I’ll send the two-page version after this call for signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. For go-live, we need training the week of August 5. Two sessions, probably Tuesday and Thursday, 45 minutes each. Can your team do that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I’m seeing availability August 6 at 11 Eastern and August 8 at 2 Eastern. If those work, I’ll include them in the rollout summary and have our onboarding lead send calendar invites once the order form is countersigned.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Those times work. Also, can you list Priya Shah as the billing contact? Our AP inbox misses these sometimes.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Absolutely. Priya Shah as billing contact, invoice to the existing AP inbox with her copied, 22 standard seats, coterm to April 30, training on August 6 and 8. Did I miss anything?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that’s it. Send the order form today if you can. I can sign tomorrow after our staff meeting.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have it by 3 PM Central today, and I’ll attach the seat breakdown so finance doesn’t have to ask twice.
